history.text:
Subject: Your Quillmint trial is live

Hi [PERSON],

You have 21 days of Studio, no card needed. The fastest way to see if Quillmint fits: send one real invoice to a real client today.

Start here: [LINK]

Mara, founder

response.text:
Subject: Your first invoice

Hi [PERSON],

Most people who stay with Quillmint send their first invoice in week one. Got a client to bill? It takes about 2 minutes: [LINK]

Mara

campaign.objective: Get new trial users to send their first real invoice within 7 days of signing up, and keep the ones who don't need a paid plan on Free instead of churning.
rules: Scheduled steps: Day 0 welcome, Day 2 tip (branding), Day 5 nudge (first invoice), Day 19 trial-ending notice. Templates are sent by the system, not the assistant.
When a user replies, answer from the Product Facts in plain email style, 2 to 5 short sentences, signed 'Quill, on behalf of Mara'.
If a user asks to stop emails or unsubscribe, confirm only. No pitch. Set handoff so the team removes them.
Anything that looks like a bug or an error message: thank them, ask for a screenshot, set handoff.
If the user's volume fits the Free plan, tell them so. Do not push an upgrade they don't need.
facts: Plans: Free = 3 invoices per month, 1 currency. Solo = $11/month: unlimited invoices, receipt scanning, up to 5 currencies. Studio = $27/month: up to 4 seats, client portal, automatic payment reminders, all currencies. Agency = $64/month: up to 15 seats, assisted migration, API access.
Annual billing gives 2 months free (Solo $110/yr, Studio $270/yr, Agency $640/yr).
Trial: 21 days of Studio, no card required. When it ends the workspace drops to Free unless the user picks a plan; nothing is deleted.
Receipt scanning: snap a photo in the mobile app or forward the email to your personal receipts@ address. Extracts vendor, date, total and tax amount.
Payment reminders (Studio and above): up to 3 scheduled reminders per invoice, wording editable.
Exports: CSV and PDF on every plan. Accountant access: read-only seat, free, on Solo and above (also during the trial).
Import: CSV import for clients and past invoices on all paid plans; Agency includes assisted migration by the team.
Tax: Quillmint supports reverse-charge and tax-exempt line items but does not give tax advice.
Not available: payroll, inventory, time tracking. Time tracking is on the roadmap with no date.
Data is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt). A DPA is available on request from the team.
Refunds: within 14 days of the first charge. Handled by a human only.
No standard discounts beyond annual billing. Any other discount needs a human.
Mobile apps on iOS and Android.

review.label: correct
review.rationale: Scheduled template sent once at the right step; content matches the facts.

response.text:
Subject: An invite for accountants on Quillmint

Hi [PERSON],

You already have access to client workspaces on Quillmint. Partner Desk pays 20% of each client you refer for their first 12 months, and gives your practice a free Agency workspace.

Interested? [LINK]

Mara, Quillmint

campaign.objective: Invite accountants and bookkeepers who already have read-only access to a client's Quillmint workspace to join Partner Desk.
rules: The invite and a single reminder 6 days later are templates. Never send a second reminder.
Answer questions only from the Partner Facts. Quote the commission exactly.
If they say no or not interested, thank them in one line and stop.
If they ask why they were contacted or how we got their address, set handoff.
Sign replies 'Quill, Partner Desk'.
Keep replies under 80 words.
facts: Partner Desk is for bookkeepers and accountants who already have clients on Quillmint or want to recommend it.
Commission: 20% of every referred paid account's subscription for its first 12 months, paid monthly.
Partners get a free Agency workspace for their own practice while they have at least 1 active referred client (first 6 months free regardless).
Referred clients get a 45-day Studio trial instead of 21 days. No other client discount.
Sign-up form: [LINK]. Approval within 2 business days by a human.

review.label: correct
review.rationale: Scheduled template sent once at the right step; content matches the facts.
